mapper.select: SELECT notice_id AS noticeId, user_id AS userId, title, content, image_path AS imagePath, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM notice ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (user_id, title, content, image_path, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imagePath}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_path = #{imagePath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
